fusions.name: Draw the Venom
fusions.desc: Kicks a target carrying one of your afflictions and uses that affliction up, dealing 9 damage and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Tainted Tread
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Walk It Off
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poisons from you, and your movement speed rises 25% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitterness Fades
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs out on an enemy, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
